title: Uwell Viscore Pro+ Triple Mango Prefilled Pod & Refill - 20mg
description: The Triple Mango Uwell Viscore Pro+ Prefilled Pod delivers a tropical flavour that layers different Mango profiles into one smooth vape. Sweet and juicy notes dominate on the inhale, with a rich, rounded Mango finish that lingers on the exhale. Each pack contains one 2ml Prefilled Pod prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and one 10ml Refill Pod that automatically tops up the pod as you vape. Together they provide up to 20,000 puffs depending on use, without the need for coil changes or messy refills. Equipped with a 0.8ohm mesh coil, the pod ensures consistent vapour production and full flavour delivery throughout. Designed exclusively for the Uwell Viscore Pro+ Prefilled Pod Kit, installation is quick and mess-free: simply click the pod and refill into place and you’re set to go.
